verdict.rationale: Sprinto ships narrow built-in AI features: an AI Editor that creates and modifies ingestion workflows from natural-language prompts, and Sprinto AI that validates uploaded evidence for relevance, scope and timeliness before audit. These are scoped, single-purpose helpers rather than a general in-product assistant you can hand compliance tasks to. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or agent for delegating arbitrary tasks, documentation of delegation scope and autonomy across modules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
